full_judgment: 16. In Zakir Ahmed's case similar question as in this cast was involved and it was argued on behalf of the University of Dhaka that the principle underlying audi alteram partem was not applicable in case of disciplinary proceedings initiated by Administrative Authorities. This contention was advanced in this Court as well as in appeal before the Supreme Court of Pakistan and both the Courts concurrently held that the contention was fallacious. After exhaustively considering Tariq Transport Co., 11 DLR (SC) 140; Farid Sons Ltd. 13 DLR (SC) 233; Ghansyam Das Vs. Board of High Schools, AIR 1956 Allahabad, 5396 and AIR 1962 (SC)1110; Province of Bombay Vs. Khushlal Das, 1950 S.C.R., 621; Dipa Pal Vs. University of Calcutta, AIR 1952 Calcutta, 595, C. Das Gupta Vs. Bijoyranjan Rakshit, AIR 1953 Calcutta, 212; Ridge Vs. Baldwin 1963 WLR 935; and University of Ceylon Vs.
